name: Reaper::register_temp_dir / Reaper::create_temp_dir / TempDirTeardown

test_list.description: Directories (with nested files) registered with the reaper no longer exist after shutdown_all and are reported Released.
create_temp_dir makes a directory named with the polaris-reaper- prefix inside the requested parent and registers it.
Drop is synchronous best effort: a reaper dropped without shutdown still deletes its temp dirs.
Windows only: a file opened with share mode 0 blocks removal; the retries end, the directory is reported Failed, the other directories are removed, and the directory stays in the leak report.

inputs.name: dir
inputs.description: A directory the reaper now owns.

output_description: Handle used to release the directory; its removal is part of shutdown_all.
